cornerstone.holders: Beijing Yian and HTCI (Huatai Capital Investment Limited) (in connection with the Beijing Yian OTC Swaps); Luhua Daosheng and HTCI (in connection with the Luhua Daosheng OTC Swaps); Aurora SF; China Hongqiao; Hyperion Venture; Tianto; Safewell
cornerstone.full_quote: Each of the Cornerstone Investors has agreed that it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period of six months from and including the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”), dispose of any of the Offer Shares it has purchased pursuant to the respective Cornerstone Investment Agreement
cornerstone.basis: six calendar months from and including the Listing Date; frees up on the six-month anniversary
cornerstone.notes: Wording: 'six months from and including the Listing Date'. Investor names from the cornerstone table on p.216.

controller_6m.notes: The Company has no controlling shareholder: 'Our Company had no controlling shareholder (within the meaning of the Listing Rules)' (p.126). Searched for '10.07', 'Undertakings by our Controlling Shareholders', 'Controlling Shareholders have undertaken', 'will not dispose' — no controlling-shareholder lock-up undertaking exists anywhere in the prospectus. The Underwriting chapter contains only the Company's Rule 10.08 undertaking (p.274).

controller_12m.notes: Same reason as controller_6m: no controlling shareholder exists, hence no Rule 10.07(1)(b) control-maintenance undertaking. Searched '10.07', '12 months from the Listing Date', 'Undertakings by our Controlling Shareholders' — no such undertaking found.
